candidates.rationale: The subprocess evaluator awaits communicate via wait_for, but its TimeoutError handler immediately returns a failed outcome without terminate, kill, process-group cleanup or wait. guards: Timeout reports False and prevents dependent agents from being verified; it does not reap the timed-out process.

candidates.rationale: The same input is hashed by BLAKE3 when import succeeds and domain-prefixed SHA-256 after ImportError. Both produce an unlabeled digest used recursively for evidence, squad roots and Merkle root. Therefore the optional dependency state changes canonical receipts for identical logical data. The fallback is documented locally but its algorithm is absent from the receipt schema.

source_checks.observation: Two different hash algorithms are selected by import availability.
Receipt has hash strings and no algorithm field.
Evidence, squad and root all use the conditional helper.

guards: Logical tick makes the input deterministic but does not fix the algorithm across environments.

candidates.rationale: Stack slots begin at 16 and grow by 8 without a frame-sizing pass or bound, while the prologue reserves a fixed 256 bytes then aligns rsp. The original exact 32nd-slot return-address claim is inaccurate: with the emitted aligned stack_top, push rbp and and rsp,-16, rsp is rbp-264 and a call writes rbp-272, the 33rd slot. At least 33 live slots followed by Alloc/Free can overwrite a stored value. No native assembly was compiled or run; this is a public backend emission defect.

source_checks.observation: Monotonic slot allocation is unbounded.
Aligned stack_top plus push/sub/and yields effective 264-byte frame.
ConstInt creates a slot; Alloc emits a call.
Free also emits a call.
Backend is publicly exported; no caller-side slot restriction here.

guards: The 16-byte alignment buys one additional slot, not an unbounded frame.
Targeted backend caller search found its definition/export, not a demonstrated deployed native path.

candidates.rationale: compile appends an entire assembly unit to self.asm and returns its clone without clearing asm, stack_offsets or next_offset. A second call on the same public backend necessarily retains prior headers/labels and register slots. No currently executing reuse caller was established; the defective behavior is in the reusable public API itself.

source_checks.observation: Output and allocation state live on self and are initialized only in new.
Each compilation appends header/BSS/text labels again.
Compilation returns the accumulated assembly without reset.

guards: Creating a new backend for each compilation avoids the issue but compile does not enforce that lifecycle.

source_checks.observation: Changed relative paths are compared directly with resolved allowed roots.
--files is resolved, then empty changed list returns 0 before any review.

guards: No resolving of changed f or common root normalization exists in the filter.

candidates.rationale: A deficit caller stores a future refill time; the next caller at the same clock value resets it to now, leaving zero tokens and reserving the same wait. For a depleted 15-RPM bucket, multiple callers each receive 4 seconds instead of successive slots. query sleeps after the lock is released. The thread lock prevents data races but not duplicate future reservations.

source_checks.observation: _refill resets future _last_refill and deficit calculation does not accumulate pending debt.
Rate-limiter result is slept independently before network dispatch.
Existing deterministic test covers only the first deficit caller.

guards: threading.Lock serializes calculation but releases before sleep.
Quota is a daily budget and is not an inter-request rate constraint.

candidates.rationale: A sensitive non-LegalTech context with no strict floor/sovereign role can retain an explicit :free model alongside a paid models array. Preflight checks only payload.models when present; the full payload is then passed to urlopen. The postflight floor check occurs after transmission. source_checks.observation: Strict/sovereign modes validate explicit model and candidates.
Explicit target and independent candidate models both enter payload.
General sensitivity does not itself enable enforce_floor.
Free-model veto iterates only candidate_list.
Request transmission precedes postflight model check.

guards: An explicit strict_model_floor, LegalTech context or SENSITIVE_SOVEREIGN role blocks this combination.
Missing key, exhausted quota and endpoint allowlist can block dispatch for independent reasons.

candidates.rationale: In this standalone demonstration, poison writes the even sentinel 0xDEAD6060, but write never checks it and replaces it with sentinel+2 after updating fields. read then sees a different even sequence and can return the data. The immediate poison/read assertion does not cover poison/write/read. This concerns the example API and its irreversible fail-stop claim, not the production manifest.

source_checks.observation: write blindly increments any seqlock state.
read and is_poisoned recognize only the exact sentinel.
Harness tests only immediate read after poison.

guards: Exclusive &mut write prevents safe simultaneous writers but does not prohibit a later write after poison.

candidates.rationale: The public add_node API accepts arbitrary id and payload bytes, and hashing concatenates them without lengths or separators. Single-node graphs (a,bc) and (ab,c) therefore feed the identical byte sequence abc to BLAKE3; cycle/toposort checks accept both. This is an encoding ambiguity independent of hash collision resistance. Edge omission adds scope, but the minimal finding needs no edge or ordering assumptions.

source_checks.observation: Node IDs and payloads are unconstrained variable-length values.
Cycle checks precede unframed id/payload updates; no edge encoding.

guards: Cycle rejection prevents cyclic graphs but not two different acyclic contents with equal serialized bytes.

candidates.rationale: poison and attempt_reset both use time.time for a duration. Forward clock correction can satisfy the cooldown without that elapsed monotonic duration; backward correction delays it. The lock is used by FisherBayesianEntropyGate, but targeted Python search found no active attempt_reset caller. This is a public lock API timing defect, not a demonstrated protected-effect bypass.

source_checks.observation: Poison timestamp is wall-clock time.
Cooldown subtraction and reset use wall-clock time.
Gate creates this ThermalLock.
Transition checks poisoned state before evaluation.

guards: asyncio.Lock serializes state changes and poison blocks writes until reset.
No production invocation of attempt_reset was found in targeted 01_KISH_ENGINE, scripts and tests Python searches.
